title: SwarVeda
tagline: The Science of Indian Classical Music
shortDescription: Interactive educational platform explaining mathematical, physical and acoustic foundations of Indian classical music.
description: Interactive educational platform explaining mathematical, physical and acoustic foundations of Indian classical music.

caseStudy.problem: Scientific and mathematical aspects of Indian classical music can be difficult to understand through conventional textual explanations.
caseStudy.solution: Interactive visual/audio experiences demonstrating frequencies, ratios, sound waves, ragas and rhythm.
features: Frequency Visualizer with note selection and Just Intonation ratios (Sa=240Hz)
Raga Explorer with Arohana, Avarohana, Vadi, and Samvadi
Rhythm Labs for Taal beat cycles and mathematical divisions
caseStudy.outcome: Interdisciplinary educational platform connecting modern web technology with IKS concepts.
